instruction: Enable night light mode on your system to reduce blue light emission after sunset.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment because night light/blue light filter settings cannot be reliably verified in the VM. While the UI controls may exist, verifying the actual color temperature shift requires display color profile analysis that is not available in the evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - night light mode's core functionality (blue light reduction/color temperature shift) cannot be semantically verified in the VM environment
While UI toggle state could theoretically be checked, this would not verify the actual requirement: 'reduce blue light emission after sunset'
Display color profile analysis needed for verification is not available in the evaluation framework
The infeasible designation is the appropriate evaluator for tasks whose semantic requirements cannot be programmatically verified
